tasks.label: Setup: Sync dependencies
tasks.detail: Create .venv with Python 3.14 and install locked development/validation dependencies. Preserve installed optional extras.

tasks.label: Setup: Sync dependencies with optional integrations
tasks.detail: Also install optional App Configuration and telemetry dependencies; does not configure or contact Azure services.

tasks.label: Setup: Check Python environment
tasks.detail: Run the Rich import/interpreter preflight without loading Azure settings.

tasks.label: Agents: Smoke test all local agents
tasks.detail: Requires all three local hosts already running. Sends real model requests sequentially and records Rich/JSONL results; can incur token charges. No deployment, grants, or automatic retries.

tasks.label: Quality: Check Story6 coordinator
tasks.detail: Local native-Responses mocks, owner-bound approval/decision/no-replay checks, and actual local host readiness. No Azure credentials, real model/MCP calls, deployment or old-story reruns.

tasks.label: Quality: Check Story6 deployment package
tasks.detail: Offline package, credential-exclusion, stale-source and runtime-role scope tests. No Docker build, Azure access, grants or deployment.

tasks.label: Quality: Check Story6 direct boundary
tasks.detail: Local synthetic transport and evidence-oracle checks; no Azure access or real searches. Confirms successful unapproved execution remains an enforcement FAIL in real evidence rather than a passing security assertion.

tasks.label: Quality: Check Story6 final report
tasks.detail: Offline final-results rendering, privacy, source integrity, task-flow diagram/check anchors and preserved direct-call FAIL. No cloud requests or private case inputs.

tasks.label: Agents: Preview hosted deployment (unsupported)
tasks.detail: Currently unsupported/skipped for hosted agents by azd. A successful exit is not a deployment plan or verification. No image build or deployment.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Explicit paid operation: remote ACR builds and immutable hosted agent versions. Existing foundation/model are reused.

tasks.label: Access: Preview hosted agent permissions
tasks.detail: Shows deployed agent model grants, Data Analysis's Monitoring Metrics Publisher, and the project identity's Monitoring Reader on Application Insights. Does not modify roles.

tasks.label: Access: Preview isolated user Consumer grants
tasks.detail: Read-only plan for the selected test users' project-scoped Foundry Agent Consumer grants. Reuses covering grants. No role writes, sign-in, profile creation, deployment, or agent calls. Does not certify absence of other permissions.

tasks.label: Access: Create isolated user auth profiles
tasks.detail: Choose optional project-scoped Foundry Agent Consumer grants under the operator CLI identity, then isolated Microsoft sign-in. No Foundry User/Owner/impersonation grants or agent calls. Passwords/MFA remain in Microsoft's UI.

tasks.label: Access: Apply hosted agent permissions
tasks.detail: Applies scoped model grants, Monitoring Metrics Publisher for Data Analysis, and Monitoring Reader for the project identity on Application Insights. Reuses existing grants; no developer, Blob, or impersonation grants.

tasks.label: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Three real remote inference requests, one per active hosted agent, using the Azure CLI user. Can incur model/session usage. Not localhost.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy and smoke test all hosted agents
dependsOn: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
tasks.detail: Explicit paid agent deployment, scoped agent RBAC, then independent hosted smoke. Does not verify delegation, isolation or recovery, or reprovision the foundation.

tasks.label: Access: Preview Supervisor impersonation permission
tasks.detail: Read-only plan: the standard hosted model/telemetry and project Insights roles, plus the Supervisor's single custom impersonation action at the selected project. Does not modify roles.

tasks.label: Access: Apply Supervisor impersonation permission
tasks.detail: Applies the standard hosted model/telemetry and project Insights roles, plus the explicit project-scoped impersonation role for Supervisor only. Does not establish working delegation. No Blob grants.

tasks.label: Agents: Diagnose hosted caller context
tasks.detail: Direct Research versus one Supervisor-to-Research presence-only probe. No model inference, workflow-state writes, grants or deployments. Missing context is reported as FAIL.

tasks.label: Agents: Test hosted identity variants and isolation
tasks.detail: Explicit opt-in hosted diagnostics: separate call-context/user-label variants, one-hour synthetic state markers and A-A-B history checks. No model calls or role changes; hosting usage applies. Genuine two-Entra-user tests remain blocked.

tasks.label: Agents: Test native Entra user isolation
tasks.detail: Verbose Rich request/response panels for real native-user Research state/history tests. Sanitized diagnostic replies, HTTP status/trace metadata, and unchanged isolation assertions. No models, grants, deployment, login, or retries.

tasks.label: Agents: Test hosted workflow state and delegation
tasks.detail: Currently blocked by missing verified specialist caller context. Paid synthetic hosted create/inspect/replay/continue, separate specialist histories and unknown-workflow rejection. No crash or OOM injection.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy and test hosted delegation
dependsOn: Agents: Smoke test all hosted agents
Agents: Test hosted workflow state and delegation
tasks.detail: Currently blocked by missing verified specialist caller context. Explicit paid deployment, model permissions, independent smoke and workflow test; no foundation reprovisioning. Fails closed rather than bypassing isolation.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 1 Enable Code Interpreter on existing Data Analysis agent
tasks.detail: Native-only readiness on the existing Data Analysis agent. Preview is local; run creates one bound session and one paid analysis, validates original outputs, and saves a separate native baseline. Never deploys, grants roles, creates an agent, or creates a toolbox.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 2 Analyze data and deliver outputs
tasks.detail: Native model-written analysis of seeded 1k-row CSV; independently checks rows/cells/totals and downloads original CSV/PNG session files. Preview is local; run makes one paid analysis. Chart meaning requires an offline hash-bound human review, not another inference. Requires native Step 1.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 3 Evaluate dataset sizes
tasks.detail: Native finite capacity ladder: baseline 1k/10k/100k or explicitly enabled pressure 250k/500k/1M rows. One analysis per size, no retries, stop at first failure/unavailable memory metric or 75% of observed interpreter limit. Preview is local; run is paid. No toolbox mutations.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 4 Assess sandbox boundaries
tasks.detail: Native application isolation with two real existing user profiles: own analysis/original downloads, foreign workflow/session-file denial, and clean-session ownership checks. Preview is local; run makes two paid analyses. No login, role changes, native-file confidentiality claim, or container deletion.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 1 - 5 Assess state continuity
tasks.detail: Step 5 selector: skip = Blob reconstruction (two analyses); observe = Blob then Hosted; only = zero-analysis Hosted idle/resume probe. Hosted proof checks platform active/idle/stopped metadata before resume, then process/HOME continuity. Preview is local. No deletion, forced stop, retries, or redesign.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 3 - 1 Demonstrate separate conversations
tasks.detail: AC1. verify = no changes. prepare-if-missing = once, azd deploy supervisor-agent so the Supervisor accepts POC_CONVERSE (same identity; Research and Data Analysis not redeployed). Paid: one Supervisor -> Research turn in a Supervisor-created Research conversation, then a model-free mapping re-read. Writes a report under step-01-separate-conversations\ and the Story 3 baseline.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 3 - 2 Verify sub-agent follow-up history
tasks.detail: AC2. Read-only reuse of the Story 3 baseline. Paid: two Supervisor -> Research turns in one mapped Research conversation (remember, then recall without resending), plus a model-free inspect of a new Supervisor conversation. Writes a report under step-02-follow-up-history\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 3 - 3 Assess conversation ownership and access
tasks.detail: AC3. Read-only reuse of the Story 3 baseline; reads role assignments only. Paid: one Supervisor -> Research turn, then model-free client-to-agent and agent-to-agent conversation reads and Supervisor mapping denials. Writes a report under step-03-ownership-and-access\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 3 - 4 Evaluate shared conversation ID
tasks.detail: AC4. Read-only reuse of the Story 3 baseline. Paid: one Supervisor seed turn, the Supervisor calling Research with its own conversation ID (agent and call-context identity), a model-free Supervisor history inspect, and one direct client -> Research control. Writes a report under step-04-shared-conversation-id\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 3 - 5 Compare shared and separate conversations
tasks.detail: AC5. Read-only reuse of the Story 3 baseline. Paid: four variants in new Supervisor conversations (separate result/placeholder, shared agent/call-context), each followed by a model-free inspect; classifies result, placeholder, or full history. Writes a report under step-05-shared-vs-separate\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 1 Demonstrate Supervisor delegation
tasks.detail: AC1. verify = no changes. prepare-if-missing = once, create the Research MCP toolbox story4-research-mcp, set RESEARCH_TOOLBOX_ENDPOINT, and azd deploy --all (same agents and identities). Paid: two model-routed Supervisor delegations (Research, Data Analysis). Writes a report under step-01-supervisor-delegation\ and the Story 4 baseline.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 2 Assess sync and async delegation
tasks.detail: AC2. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline. Paid: Supervisor -> Research synchronous and background delegation, each with a simulated sub-agent failure, plus one direct background request to Research and one client background POC_DELEGATE that the Supervisor must reject. No retries. Writes a report under step-02-sync-async-and-failure\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 3 Demonstrate Research tool call
tasks.detail: AC3. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline. Direct toolbox MCP probe plus one paid Supervisor -> Research request that calls the Microsoft Learn MCP search tool. Writes a report under step-03-research-tool-call\ with the trust-boundary table.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 4 Evaluate identity paths
tasks.detail: AC4. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline; reads (never grants) the Supervisor's impersonation permission. Paid: Supervisor -> Research in agent-owned, call-context, and delegated-user modes, plus agent-owned Research -> toolbox. Writes a report under step-04-identity-paths\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 5 Trace identity and access
tasks.detail: AC5. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline; reads role assignments only. Paid: one traced client -> Supervisor -> Research -> tool request, then platform (impersonation, toolbox allowed_tools) and application (allow-list) denials. Writes a report under step-05-trace-and-access\.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 6 Demonstrate Data Analysis via Supervisor
tasks.detail: AC6. Native stateless Supervisor compatibility probe using the existing agents and reviewed native Story 1 evidence. Preview is local; run is a bounded best-effort attempt, not a workflow redesign. A missing trusted native contract is reported as blocked, with redesign proposed only for your approval.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 4 - 7 Invoke Research directly
tasks.detail: AC7. Read-only reuse of the Story 4 baseline. Creates one conversation per agent, then two paid requests only to Research in its own conversation (no Supervisor). Writes a report under step-07-direct-invocation\.

tasks.label: Agents: Preview Story6 deployment package
tasks.detail: Credential-free local preview. Does not read env values, build, deploy or change the root three-agent manifest/environment.

tasks.label: Agents: Story6 MCP - Test local fixture and approval route
tasks.detail: Local signed-JWT/MCP boundary and coordinator protocol checks only. No Azure writes, model requests or hosted validation claim.

tasks.label: Access: Story6 MCP - Preview API permission
tasks.detail: Read-only Graph check: exact API name/settings and verified coordinator workload identity (Foundry ServiceIdentity or ManagedIdentity). No users, secrets or grants.

tasks.label: Access: Story6 MCP - Apply API permission
dependsOn: Access: Story6 MCP - Preview API permission
tasks.detail: Explicit identity write: one single-tenant API and Story6.Invoke assignment for the selected coordinator. Prints API audience/scope. No client secrets, user grants, agent or tool deployment.

tasks.label: Agents: Story6 MCP - Prepare coordinator package
tasks.detail: Local stage-only direct-Entra override. Does not edit root env, change old routes, build or deploy. Use the existing Verify/Deploy Story6 coordinator tasks afterward.

tasks.label: Agents: Story6 MCP - Build tool image
tasks.detail: Explicit remote image build from the verified allowlisted package, not the worktree. No credentials in build context. Choose a new immutable test tag; no agent deployment.

tasks.label: Agents: Story6 MCP - Preview tool infrastructure
tasks.detail: Read-only what-if: isolated tool app/environment/pull identity and registry-scoped AcrPull. Existing registry must be in this group. No original agent resources.

tasks.label: Agents: Story6 MCP - Deploy tool
dependsOn: Agents: Story6 MCP - Preview tool infrastructure
tasks.detail: Explicit provision/deploy after separately building the image. One replica, one process, HTTPS + app-validated Entra auth. Outputs MCP URL/scope; does not deploy any agent.

tasks.label: Agents: Story6 MCP - Hosted approval test
tasks.detail: Use start/inspect/approve on one case, then start/reject on a NEW case. Requires the direct-Entra coordinator deployment. Review pending case_id before deciding; compare actual server counts/logs separately.

tasks.label: Agents: Story6 MCP - Observe execution receipts
tasks.detail: Read-only bounded log view. Match case ID and epoch; absence of a log alone is not proof of no execution. Use /health total/epoch before and after each sequential case.

tasks.label: Agents: Prepare isolated Story6 deployment package
tasks.detail: Local files only: stage one service, reviewed source/lock and allowlisted non-secret bindings under ignored artifacts. No tokens/old AGENT_* values, Docker build, Azure writes or automatic deployment.

tasks.label: Agents: Verify Story6 deployment package
tasks.detail: Read-only local drift check against staged payload, selected env and root manifest. No build/deploy/grants; stale packages require a fresh prepare/review.

tasks.label: Access: Preview Story6 coordinator runtime permissions
tasks.detail: Read-only: resolve only the new active coordinator identity and its Foundry User assignment at the selected Foundry account. No old-agent/user/storage/telemetry/impersonation grants.

tasks.label: Access: Apply Story6 coordinator runtime permissions
dependsOn: Access: Preview Story6 coordinator runtime permissions
tasks.detail: Explicit role write if missing: built-in Foundry User at the selected Foundry account for only the new coordinator's verified managed identity. Reuses covering assignments; no old-agent/user/Owner/Contributor/impersonation/storage/telemetry changes.

tasks.label: Agents: Preview Story6 approval toolbox
tasks.detail: Read-only exact-name/configuration check for isolated story6-approval-mcp; no old toolbox, connection or role changes.

tasks.label: Agents: Prepare Story6 approval toolbox
tasks.detail: Create only the isolated search-only toolbox with approval=always, or reuse its exact immutable version. Does not alter Story4 toolbox, grants or agent versions. A mismatched existing definition blocks rather than overwrites.

tasks.label: Agents: Deploy Story6 coordinator
tasks.detail: Build and deploy only the new coordinator from the verified isolated package. Never root --all/provision, role grants or old-agent deployment. Stop on failure rather than automatically rebuilding.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 6 - 1 Verify approval readiness
tasks.detail: preview = zero requests; qualify = offline real-SDK/synthetic peers; run = read-only deployment/runtime-role metadata. No deployment, grants or model inference.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 6 - 2 Demonstrate approval and rejection
tasks.detail: Preview by default. Run starts a pinned case or explicitly inspects/approves/rejects the saved pending case. Start never auto-approves. Keep the printed case locator private; existing agents are not deployed or modified.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 6 - 3 Discover and decide pending approvals
tasks.detail: Fresh-client inspect of the original saved case; does not create a replacement session or model request. Use Step 2's explicit approve/reject action to decide. No Event Grid/webhook support is inferred.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 6 - 4 Observe pause state and resume
tasks.detail: Operator-owned case: actual stored conversation items, authenticated caller/operation correlation and file hash before/after inspection. No restart/replacement/model request. For true pre-start history use CLI Step2 --capture-history; continuation retains auditing automatically.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 6 - 5 Test direct MCP approval boundary
tasks.detail: Authorized direct proxy test: immutable approval=always metadata, valid-token permission control and no-approval call, then existing Consumer-user permission denial. Unapproved execution stays FAIL as an enforcement gap. Upstream Learn is public; no credential is sent to it directly.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 6 - 6 Verify caller and approver access
tasks.detail: Two existing isolated CLI users against coordinator v1: A pending control, B own-route control, B foreign inspect/decision attempts, then A unchanged. Start leaves A pending; explicitly choose A inspect/approve/reject with its private locator. No login, role writes or redeployment. Protected-MCP authorization remains separate.

tasks.label: Agents: Build Story6 final-results HTML
tasks.detail: Offline final-results deep dive for all five Issue6 criteria, including expandable task-flow diagrams with exact check links. No private artifacts, deployment timeline or cloud calls. Keeps direct-call FAIL. Regenerates only unchanged inputs; changed findings require a fresh output.

tasks.label: Agents: Story 6 - 7 Build evidence report
tasks.detail: Offline HTML from one explicitly selected Story6 bundle-config.json; no new tests/cloud calls. Preserves FAIL/BLOCKED and identifies the separately maintained Markdown issue report. Does not generate a passing hosted verdict.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Preview changes (Azure CLI)
tasks.detail: Read-only native what-if. Uses the checked-in North Central US preview inputs; does not provision or grant permissions.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Preview changes (azd)
tasks.detail: Requires an initialized azd environment; the preprovision hook validates the subscription, environment name, and region.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Apply changes (azd)
tasks.detail: MUTATES AZURE and can incur charges. Run only after reviewing the native what-if. Does not invoke developer RBAC grants.

tasks.label: Infrastructure: Inspect deployment operations
tasks.detail: Inspect operations after deployment. Inspect nested operations with az deployment operation group list.

tasks.label: Setup: Create .env from deployment
tasks.detail: Discovers the latest successful deployment for the selected environment. Creates .env without overwriting an existing file.

tasks.label: Setup: Update .env from deployment
tasks.detail: Refreshes only project endpoint, model deployment, and optional App Configuration endpoint. Preserves all other local values.

tasks.label: Access: Preview developer permissions
tasks.detail: Separate from deployment; reads outputs from the deployed foundation and previews missing scoped roles.

tasks.label: Access: Apply developer permissions
tasks.detail: Explicitly grants displayed missing roles, then verifies synthetic Blob/monitoring access. Never runs as a provisioning/debug hook.

tasks.label: Debug: Start Story6 coordinator for Inspector
tasks.detail: Starts only the isolated Story6 host. Readiness requests no model inference; commands reject missing verified Hosted caller/session context. Optional configured integrations retain their existing behavior. No deployment or grants.

tasks.label: Debug: Open Story6 Inspector
dependsOn: Debug: Start Story6 coordinator for Inspector

inputs.description: Actual Story6 coordinator workload PRINCIPAL OBJECT ID printed by Preview API permission. Not client ID, project ID or tool-host pull identity.
Custom MCP API application/client ID printed by Apply API permission. Never use a Foundry audience or token.
Exact HTTPS Container App /mcp URL printed by tool deployment. No query string or credentials.
Existing POC ACR name (not URL), in the selected tool resource group.
Existing POC resource group containing the selected ACR. Tool-only resources are created here.
New image tag for this reviewed fixture build; do not overwrite a tag used by an earlier test.
One existing Consumer CLI-profile user for the direct toolbox access-denial control. No role change or sign-in; leave blank to record that control as BLOCKED.
Blank = original public Learn; positive immutable version printed by Prepare Story6 approval toolbox = authenticated proxy. Only the staged package is configured; root env/old agents unchanged.
start = new pending case only; inspect/approve/reject = use the exact saved locator. Review the real pending tool/query before deciding.
Blank for a NEW start; otherwise exact private case-state.json printed by that start. Never publish this locator or substitute another case.
Exact isolated package directory printed by Prepare Story6 deployment package. Do not select the root project or paste credentials.
preview = zero requests; qualify = offline SDK experiments; run = read-only active-version/runtime-role check
preview = operation summary; run = selected hosted action. Step5 tests the isolated authenticated toolbox proxy; Step6 uses two existing CLI profiles.
Exact path to a saved Story6 run's bundle-config.json printed by Step 1 qualification or a blocked run. Never enter credentials.
Report root under artifacts; output is <root>\story-6\html. Choose a fresh root for a different bundle, e.g. artifacts\story-6\hosted-report. No originals are overwritten.
preview = local operation summary only; run = execute the separately approved paid native validation budget (no deployment/grants/deletion)
baseline = original 1k/10k/100k cases; pressure = separately approved 250k/500k/1M ladder, also requiring backend pressure enablement

skip = Blob only (two analyses); observe = Blob then Hosted; only = zero-analysis Hosted probe. Five-minute minimum quiet, up to six read-only state checks, eight-minute quiet cap. Keep machine awake. No forced stop/delete.
verify = no changes; prepare-if-missing = azd deploy only the EXISTING supervisor-agent once if it does not yet accept POC_CONVERSE
verify = no changes; prepare-if-missing = create the Story 4 Research MCP toolbox and azd deploy --all the EXISTING agents once if not already done
Choose native-user test output detail

options.label: Verbose - request/response panels and full details
Not verbose - request labels and assertion summaries

inputs.description: RBAC: consumer = grant only Foundry Agent Consumer on the selected project before sign-in; none = authentication only. Run from your operator/admin CLI context.
Comma-separated full user sign-in names, e.g. user1@tenant.onmicrosoft.com,user2@tenant.onmicrosoft.com. Never enter passwords.
Explicit Azure subscription name or ID
Exact timestamped subscription deployment name for operation inspection (az deployment sub list)
Environment whose latest successful deployment will be discovered
Local identity to grant (azd must match the az CLI user)
